race.comment: SILKY SETH (5) resumes. He was racing consistently last time in, placing in a few races in a row and should now be an improver into this campaign. 1300m is probably on the sharper side but he's got good ability and Shinn goes on. SARAPO (4) is back after a break of four months. Went close to a maiden win before the layoff, finishing third at his latest appearance over 2100m at Wyong. Has ability but is in the same boat over a trip short of his best. SAKURA JENNI (13) resumes having run well on debut at Swan Hill, just finding one better. Capable of a big return. WINDHOWLER (7) is resuming from a spell. Fitter for recent hit-outs including a Flemington jump-out win. Opened last campaign with a eighth at Sandown-Hillside over 1300m. In the mix fresh.
